authority: Original PR #1 alpha-discovery continuation. The user explicitly prioritizes terminal wealth and allows replacement of the existing risk/ownership architecture during discovery while preserving causal next-session execution and frozen data/evidence identities.

committed_offensive_attribution.finding: The broad-pool 2025 failure was predominantly ownership opportunity cost at near-full exposure. The unchanged native trend_book owner emitted causal LATCHED_LEADER_REPLACEMENT signals before the later high-PnL entrants.

alpha_decay_local_diagnostic.finding: A custom admission-reference displacement improved common-five and leader-removal but materially regressed union. This supports preserving the native ownership lifecycle instead of inventing another challenger threshold.

economic_hypothesis: The baseline trend_book already contains the sparse causal replacement, readmission and actual-cash funding behavior that identified decisive broad-universe winners, but its account RiskState repeatedly cuts or delays gross exposure. Retain the native security/ownership lifecycle exactly and remove only account-level de-risking so the same causal owner can remain offensively funded through large AI trends.
control: Exact research.trend_book.Owner with Parameters(2), including its existing RiskState.

treatment.ownership: Exact trend_book/coherent security eligibility, score ranking, native 20-session LATCHED_LEADER_REPLACEMENT predicate, exit_pending/readmit lifecycle, actual-fill accounting, quantity ceilings, observed-cash funding, restoration bookkeeping and per-name ceilings. Do not introduce a new replacement threshold or review clock.
treatment.account_risk: Replace only the account RiskState authority with a stateless offensive authority whose cap is 1.0 from the first decision and remains 1.0. It records OFFENSIVE_FULL_CAP and never issues account/market de-risking, recovery waits or restoration transitions.
treatment.security_risk: Unchanged signal-specific security breaks, stale-quote exits, -8% one-session break, market admission gate, pending protective security exits, price-limit handling and fill retries remain authoritative.
treatment.execution: Unchanged close decision / next-session execution, sells before buys, cash-only long-only, no leverage, no shorting, prior-volume liquidity, board lots, T+1, real fees/slippage and limit handling.

structural_difference_from_rejected_work: Not old handover/generic reentry/relative_campaign_owner: adds no new handoff rule, score multiple, rank cutoff, confirmation interval or campaign label; it reuses the native owner unchanged.
Not committed_offensive_core: does not freeze occupied slots; the native owner keeps its causal replacement and real-cash funding lifecycle.

Not an old risk patch: it adds no defensive filter and does not optimize drawdown. It removes account-level de-risking entirely for the offensive alpha experiment while leaving security execution protections intact.
Not a funding/allocation-weight search: no new weight, cap, position-count or cash-allocation parameter is introduced.

measurement.primary_objective: maximize mean(log(terminal wealth)) across the three fixed scopes
measurement.secondary_objective: maximize minimum terminal wealth across the three fixed scopes
measurement.promotion_rule: Advance only if cross-scope compound wealth and the minimum wealth improve, at least one broad scope improves, and joint optical-leader removal remains above 1.0. MDD/orders/turnover are diagnostics only at this stage.
measurement.failure_rule: If the fixed three-scope wealth result is not materially better, preserve the failure and move to a substantively different alpha architecture. Do not tune RiskState levels, replacement multiples, review cadence, position count or score weights.

prohibitions: No future labels or future highs in decisions
